<thought>First, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that, on the flavanone product (SMILES "O=C1C2=CC=CC=C2O1c3ccccc3"), form an ether oxygen and break aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, as described in the reaction. This should return the appropriate template ID and its mapped reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C2=CC=CC=C2O1c3ccccc3",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
